events.title: The Rubicon
events.body: Your pontifex speaks the rite at the water's edge, the birds are read, and the gods give their leave. Far off, a column of legionaries is already crossing a bridge that was not there before.

signs.title: The Rubicon
signs.body: A sacred boundary. No army crosses the Rubicon without the gods' leave; only a pontifex may bridge it.

signs.title: The Via Appia
signs.body: The Appian Way runs south to Brundisium and the sea.

signs.title: Roma
signs.body: All roads lead here. Emperor Traianus holds court within.

signs.title: The Apennines
signs.body: This stony spine divides the peninsula, coast from coast.

signs.title: The Strait
signs.body: Across the water lies Sicilia, granary of the Republic.

signs.title: The Tiber
signs.body: Father Tiber, who carries the grain up from Ostia to Rome.

signs.title: The Padus
signs.body: The Padus, king of Italia's rivers, runs from the Alps to the Adriatic.

signs.title: Alesia
signs.body: Here Vercingetorix laid down his arms before Caesar.

signs.title: The Rhine
signs.body: This river marks the edge of the world. Beyond it, Germania.

signs.title: Britannia
signs.body: Across the northern sea lies Britannia, and Londinium upon it.

signs.title: Hadrian's Wall
signs.body: The Emperor's wall runs from sea to sea. Beyond it, Caledonia answers to no one.

signs.title: Carthago
signs.body: Thrice Roma fought her; thrice she fell. Carthago delenda est.

signs.title: The Sahara
signs.body: South lies the sand. A day of marching buys a single tile.

signs.title: The Grain Fleet
signs.body: From these ports the corn ships sail to feed a million in Roma.

signs.title: The Mulucha
signs.body: Beyond the river lies Mauretania, and the Moors keep its only bridge.

signs.title: The Oracle of Amun
signs.body: Alexander came this way to ask the god who his father was. The god's guardians still keep the pass.

signs.title: Palmyra
signs.body: Oasis of the caravans, where Zenobia named herself Augusta.

signs.title: The Euphrates
signs.body: The bridge at Zeugma. East lies Parthia, the border Roma never truly held.

signs.title: The Silk Road
signs.body: The road from the East ends here. Its wealth passes through Antiochia.

signs.title: The Cilician Gates
signs.body: One road through the Taurus, cut so narrow that a loaded camel scrapes both walls.

signs.title: Armenia
signs.body: Kings of Armenia take their crowns from Roma or from Parthia, whichever army is nearer.

dialog.body:
Emperor Traianus bids you welcome, Hero.

Return with the stolen Aquila of the Legions and all the provinces of Roma are yours.

audience.intro:
Trumpets announce your arrival with imperial fanfare.

Emperor Traianus rises from his throne to greet you and proclaims:
audience.rank_up:
Ave, %NAME%, legate of Roma.

I now raise you to the rank of %RANK%.
audience.more_needed:
Ave, %NAME%, legate of Roma.

I can aid you better after you've captured %NEEDED% more enemies.
audience.final_rank:
Ave, %NAME%, legate of Roma.

You are %RANK% now. Hurry and recover the Aquila of the Legions, or all Roma will be lost!
audience.blessing_granted:
%NAME%, beloved of the gods,

you have returned every sacred artifact of Roma to her keeping. Rise with the blessing of your Emperor and of the gods.
audience.blessing_needed:
%NAME%, beloved of the gods,

I bless only one who has gathered every sacred artifact of Roma. Find the %NEEDED% still missing, then come before me again.
audience.blessing_already:
%NAME%, beloved of the gods,

you already carry my blessing.

It is given only once.
audience.tribute_paid:
Amice %NAME%,

Roma thanks you. Your gift will be spoken of in the Senate, and the gods will remember it on the field.
audience.tribute_needed:
Amice %NAME%,

Tribute to your Emperor is 50000 gold.

You are %NEEDED% gold short. Return when your purse can bear it.

artifacts.name: The Sibylline Fragment
artifacts.effect: Its power is not yet revealed.
